instructions.setup: Stand tall, shoulder-width grip, bar at thighs, elbows pinned to your sides.
instructions.execution: Curl the bar up by flexing the elbows, keep the upper arms still, lower under control.
instructions.commonMistakes: Swinging the torso, letting the elbows drift forward, using momentum.
instructions.safetyNotes: Keep a neutral wrist; drop the weight if the lower back starts to arch.

instructions.setup: Grab a heavy load in each hand, stand tall, brace the core, pull the shoulders back.
instructions.execution: Walk with short controlled steps for the set distance or time, keep the load from swinging.
instructions.commonMistakes: Shrugging into the ears, leaning to one side, rushing the steps.
instructions.safetyNotes: Set the weights down under control; do not drop from a rounded back.

instructions.setup: Place the rear foot on a bench, front foot forward, torso tall, weight in the front heel.
instructions.execution: Lower straight down until the front thigh is near parallel, drive through the front heel to stand.
instructions.commonMistakes: Front knee caving in, pushing off the back foot, torso collapsing forward.
instructions.safetyNotes: Start bodyweight to find balance before loading; keep the front knee tracking over the toes.
